competences.description: Attacks all enemies to grant Irresistible for 2 turns.

Attacks all enemies 3 times. The first hit steals 1 beneficial effect with a 50% chance, the second hit increases their chance of landing a Glancing Hit for 2 turns with a 50% chance, and the third hit grants Oblivion for 2 turns with a 50% chance. Gains 1 stack of Chaos Force whenever attacking an enemy granted with Irresistible.

Attacks all enemies. Gains 5 stacks of Chaos Force if the boss attacks an enemy with no beneficial effects. When attacking enemies granted with Irresistible, Chaos Force increases by the number of those enemies.

Decreases the HP of all enemies by 1% per stack of Chaos Force, and then attacks all enemies. The damage dealt increases by 1% per stack of Chaos Force. This attack does not activate passive skills of the enemies.
